verdict.rationale: Sierra's own Insights and Explorer products monitor live conversations: they track metrics like CSAT and resolution, surface emerging issues in weekly briefings, and show per-action reasoning. Ghostwriter can turn raw transcripts into agent changes, and Agent Checks and Simulations catch regressions. However, these simulations are pre-release testing, not ongoing QA of production conversations. Nothing documents per-conversation QA scoring of samples, explicit failure flagging, or a structured review queue that routes findings into fixes. Missing for 10: scored conversation samples/QA rubrics, explicit flagged-failure workflow, documented review-to-fix loop, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, AI conversations get ongoing QA — scored samples, flagged failures, and a review loop that feeds fixes back into the agent

citations.quote: Explorer automatically delivers a weekly briefing on key trends, emerging issues, and recommendations — without you having to ask.
Track how your agent performs against your most critical metrics, like CSAT, case resolution, and more.
Understand the reasoning behind every agent action or answer—view knowledge sources, systems accessed, and more.
Explorer identifies the answer across thousands of real conversations.
Upload SOPs, raw transcripts, or even audio interviews of subject matter experts to create customer journeys from scratch.
